Tuning Results Summarised by Performance Quantile Tier

Source: R/tbl_tuning_by_quantile.R
tbl_tuning_by_quantile.Rd

Bins tuning candidates into tiers by a performance metric (tier 1 is the best) and summarises each tier: the number of candidates, the metric range, the mean penalty (`lambda`) and mixing parameter (`alpha`), or how often each model term occurs in the candidates of the tier.

Usage

tbl_tuning_by_quantile(
  tuning_results,
  metric = "IBS",
  n_tiles = 5,
  lower_is_better = TRUE,
  what = c("summary", "terms")
)

Arguments

tuning_results

A data frame of candidates, or anything [as_tuning_results()] accepts. Needs the `metric` column; `lambda`, `alpha` and `formula` are used when present.

metric

Name of the performance column (default `"IBS"`).

n_tiles

Number of tiers (quantile groups of equal size, up to ties).

lower_is_better

`TRUE` when a smaller metric is better (IBS, error); `FALSE` otherwise.

what

`"summary"` (one row per tier) or `"terms"` (one row per tier and model term, with the number and share of the tier's candidates that contain it; needs a `formula` column).

Value

A tibble. `"summary"`: `tier`, `n_models`, `metric_min`, `metric_mean`, `metric_max`, `mean_lambda`, `mean_alpha` (the last two `NA` when absent). `"terms"`: `tier`, `term`, `n_with_term`, `n_models`, `retention`.

See also

[as_tuning_results()], [compare_tuning_runs()], [select_candidate_models()]

Examples

set.seed(1)
tr <- data.frame(IBS = runif(50, 0.1, 0.3), alpha = runif(50), lambda = 10^runif(50, -3, 0),
                 formula = sample(c("~ a + b", "~ a + c", "~ b + c"), 50, TRUE))
tbl_tuning_by_quantile(tr, n_tiles = 4)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 7
#>    tier n_models metric_min metric_mean metric_max mean_lambda mean_alpha
#>   <int>    <int>      <dbl>       <dbl>      <dbl>       <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1     1       12      0.103       0.131      0.153      0.135       0.465
#> 2     2       13      0.168       0.188      0.211      0.0434      0.525
#> 3     3       12      0.215       0.233      0.246      0.186       0.462
#> 4     4       13      0.254       0.271      0.298      0.215       0.555
tbl_tuning_by_quantile(tr, n_tiles = 4, what = "terms")
#> # A tibble: 12 × 5
#>     tier term  n_with_term n_models retention
#>    <int> <chr>       <int>    <int>     <dbl>
#>  1     1 a              10       12     0.833
#>  2     1 b               8       12     0.667
#>  3     1 c               6       12     0.5  
#>  4     2 c              13       13     1    
#>  5     2 b              10       13     0.769
#>  6     2 a               3       13     0.231
#>  7     3 a               8       12     0.667
#>  8     3 b               8       12     0.667
#>  9     3 c               8       12     0.667
#> 10     4 a              10       13     0.769
#> 11     4 b               8       13     0.615
#> 12     4 c               8       13     0.615
